paper.title: Household heterogeneity and the transmission of foreign shocks

model.name: HANKSOME
model.full_name: Heterogeneous-Agent New-Keynesian Small Open Model Economy
key_features: Flexible vs. fixed exchange rate regimes

key_findings.claim_1: Foreign-currency debt revaluation amplifies consumption contraction when leverage is concentrated among poor (high-MPC) households
key_findings.claim_2: Fixed exchange rate regime improves welfare over flexible FX despite causing a deeper output recession
key_findings.claim_3: HANKSOME rationalises 'fear of floating' in emerging markets
